_description: SS taxable fraction in the 50% zone. Tests IRS provisional income formula.
_rationale: Single filer, Florida, SS $20k + pension $20k (before_tax) both at age 62, haircut disabled. Provisional income = $20k + 0.5 * $20k = $30k. Single thresholds $25k/$34k → 50% zone. SS taxable = min(0.5 * ($30k - $25k), 0.5 * $20k) = $2,500. Combined taxable gross = $22,500. Standard deduction (2026) = $16,100. Taxable income = $6,400. Federal tax = $640 (10%). Net income = $40k - $640 = $39,360/yr.
name: SS Taxable Fraction 50%
